raw: “I grind my coffee by hand each morning. I keep the beans in a blue tin, so I get that out, and the grinder is clamped to the kitchen counter. That’s the part I think of when you say morning—standing at the counter, turning the handle. It takes a little time, but I rather like having something to do with my hands. The tin is what comes into my head first, actually, that blue. Colors make me think of the lighting store where I work. I’m a cashier there. But before I get onto thinking about work, there’s the coffee, and getting the beans ground.”
